gru_definition: one-layer unidirectional GRU over the same binned representation; last valid packed hidden state -> Linear class head
model_selection: highest validation Balanced Accuracy; ties use lower validation CE; residual epoch 0 is a valid frozen-Linear checkpoint
neural_scaling: train-only per-channel RMS over valid bins

representation_semantics.fixed250: 16-sample (250 ms at 64 Hz) event-count bins over the 256-sample padded timeline; final partial valid bin retained
representation_semantics.relative10: np.array_split of each valid gesture prefix into 10 relative-progress chunks, followed by channel-wise event sums

residual_definition: frozen Linear logits plus zero-initialized Local, Transition, or Local+Transition residual logits
slurm_execution: one CPU baseline job fits all 30 frozen Linear baselines; afterok launches 120 one-core neural array tasks; afterok finalizer aggregates existing artifacts only
